thread:
zane: Heads up — staging p99 jumped ~2.3x after onboarding checkpoint v3.4.3 merge. Seeing a lot of KV evictions and kernel fallbacks. CI perf test flagged failure: https://ci.redwood/12345 :eyes:

ci-bot: perf-suite/staging failed: p99_latency > 300ms (baseline 120ms). Artifacts: https://artifacts.redwood/ci/1931234567/perf.html

claire: on it. can you paste the profiler output and the last few runtime logs?

mohit: grabbing traces + flamegraph now, running a quick bisect to narrow it down.

mohit: git bisect points to commit a7b3f2 — "tokenizer: normalize-unicode + remap table update". That change bumped the default tokenization config.

kevin: hmm. why would a tokenizer patch spike KV evictions? seq length distribution change?

mohit: exact theory: tokenizer remap altered EOS+padding handling -> more short-prefix tokens plus a noisy tail of long sequences. That makes prefix caching much less effective and leads to higher KV churn. Profiling snippets below.

```
runtime.prof:
kv.evictions_per_min: 0.34   # baseline 0.02
batch.size.dist: {1:0.12, 2-8:0.55, 64-512:0.03}
median.seq_len: 78 -> 16 (post-change)
kernel.selection.log:
-> selected kernel fast_gemm_q for batch(32, seq=16)
-> fallback to general_kernel for batch(8, varying_seq)
```

claire: so the kernel selector is getting mixed-shape batches and choosing a slower general kernel, plus the KV cache is being invalidated more often. any logs showing eviction reasons?

mohit: yes — eviction reason: "key_conflict_seq_shift" in many entries. Also saw a surge in small batches with high seq variance which trips our batching heuristic.

kevin: we haven't changed the kernel selector recently; this looks like emergent behaviour from tokenization. Two mitigations: 1) pin tokenizer config back to previous default in staging (fast), 2) add a quick batching heuristic: split batches with high seq_stddev or high kv_eviction_rate. I'll draft a patch.

zane: what's the minimal immediate action? rollback tokenizer or revert the onboarding?

claire: rolling back tokenizer config to the previous profile in staging now: `kubectl set env deploy/serving TOKENIZER_PROFILE=stable-20240115 && kubectl rollout restart deploy/serving` — starting at 1931234689.

mohit: opened a bisect PR and a hotfix branch. PR: https://git.redwood/repo/pull/2709 — changes: batching: split variable-length batches; add kv_eviction_rate safeguard to prefer stable kernels; unit tests + local perf run. Local repro: p99 down from 310ms -> 128ms.

kevin: quick heuristic patch (in PR) is basically:

```
if (batch.seq_stddev > 40 || runtime_metrics.kv_eviction_rate > 0.1) {
  // prefer stable, per-seqlen kernels and don't pack high-variance requests together
  split_batch_on_variance(batch)
}
```

ci-bot: PR 2709: perf-check queued. (`perf-suite/quick`)

perf-bot: acknowledged. Scheduling a canary perf run for staging traffic after rollout finishes.

zane: if the config rollback doesn't clear perf within 30m, plan B is revert commit a7b3f2 from main and stop the onboarding until we do a tokenizer+runtime integration test.

mohit: timeline: bisect completed at +12m, PR opened at +22m, tokenizer rollback started at +25m (kubectl rollout at 1931234689). I'll keep collecting traces and post the flamegraph here when available.

kevin: will also add a metric to track "mixed_batch_fallbacks" so we can alert earlier. Quick patch in the PR adds that counter.

claire: staging rollback is progressing — pods are restarting. perf bot will kick off a run once pods are ready.

mohit: flamegraph uploaded: https://artifacts.redwood/perf/1931234567/flame.svg — shows hot path in kv::evict_due_to_seq_shift and runtime::batcher::pack_mixed_shapes.

zane: awesome work. once staging is stable, let's schedule a postmortem to update onboarding checklist: include tokenization distribution checks, canary with KV metrics, and a kernel-selection smoke test.

claire: agreed. I'll draft the incident doc after we confirm stability. :thumbsup:

kevin: PR 2709 perf-check result: green on local quick-suite. Waiting on CI full perf. If CI passes, I'll merge and backport to the release branch (and still keep tokenizer pinned until we have a longer canary).

mohit: tagging oncall @mohit for visibility. Will update here when staging perf numbers are back.

zane: thanks everyone. Keep replies short here — updates only. :eyes:
